title: Bread and Circuses
text: The lower town is restless, and the Gate has been loud. Men gather on corners, falling quiet when a House's colors pass. The last time the city went this hungry for distraction, the old men say, it found one in a burning, and they still remember the smell.

options.label: Fund the games, before the city finds its own (30 Gold).

outcomes.text: Your House pays for masks, wine and a pageant of the Pact. Your name is cheered in the streets, and the masks are worn for weeks after.

options.label: Let the other Houses pay; your Gold has better uses than wine.

outcomes.text: You keep your purse closed and watch who pays, and who does not.

together.text: No House pays. The festival never happens; the people do not forget it.
Every House pays. The games are spoken of for a generation.
